name: Groove Synthesis 3rd Wave
description: Groove Synthesis 3rd Wave wavetable synthesizer (24K keyboard, 24M and 8M desktop modules): every settable parameter of its MIDI spec's NRPN table, with its ranges and value lists.

sources.title: 3rd Wave MIDI CC + SysEx Spec v2.0 (v2a)
sources.notes: NRPN parameters and the lists after them (PDF pages 18 - 46) read by tools/profiles/groove/read-groove-spec.mjs from 3rdWave_MIDI_SPEC_v2a.pdf (sha256 60b4a96ea7b13ba5cb907065476686a7df05a124e9dd4da0fc49ddfe869885ee), https://groovesynthesis.com/support/ (3rd Wave MIDI SPEC, download resource 3321). The edit buffer request and its reply as its "Importing / Exporting Program Data via MIDI SysEx" prints them (PDF pages 48 - 52). Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/groove/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/groove/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the spec's NRPN table, sent as that NRPN with a 14-bit value (CC 99, CC 98, CC 6, CC 38). The instrument's MIDI param receive must include NRPN. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

A Multi parameter has a value for each of a program's four parts; it is sent to the parts NRPN 0 (Edit part, a bitmap: 1 part 1, 2 part 2, 3 both …) selects, so set that first. With the global setting MIDI include part in NRPN on, part 2's are 1000 higher, part 3's 2000 and part 4's 3000; this profile does not lay those out.
The mod slots' sources (NRPN 181 - 196) print a range of 0 - 26 and the spec's list of mod sources has 30 (to MIDI Breath Control, 29): laid out as the list.
Left out, the program name, a character an NRPN: NRPN 1 - 32.
Left out, rows the spec marks deprecated: 48 Hold button select, 51 Unison off / on, 52 Unison voice count, 53 Unison key assign, 54 Unison detune, 75 Sequencer quantization.

Left out, rows whose value packs two fields (`See descrip`): 102 Osc1 wavetable, 103 Osc2 wavetable, 104 Osc3 wavetable, 371 Sequencer song part 1 play count and pattern index, 372 Sequencer song part 2 play count and pattern index, 373 Sequencer song part 3 play count and pattern index, 374 Sequencer song part 4 play count and pattern index, 375 Sequencer song part 5 play count and pattern index, 376 Sequencer song part 6 play count and pattern index, 377 Sequencer song part 7 play count and pattern index, 378 Sequencer song part 8 play count and pattern index, 379 Sequencer song part 9 play count and pattern index, 380 Sequencer song part 10 play count and pattern index, 381 Sequencer song part 11 play count and pattern index, 382 Sequencer song part 12 play count and pattern index, 383 Sequencer song part 13 play count and pattern index, 384 Sequencer song part 14 play count and pattern index, 385 Sequencer song part 15 play count and pattern index, 386 Sequencer song part 16 play count and pattern index, 387 Sequencer song part 17 play count and pattern index, 388 Sequencer song part 18 play count and pattern index, 389 Sequencer song part 19 play count and pattern index, 390 Sequencer song part 20 play count and pattern index, 391 Sequencer song part 21 play count and pattern index, 392 Sequencer song part 22 play count and pattern index, 393 Sequencer song part 23 play count and pattern index, 394 Sequencer song part 24 play count and pattern index, 444 N/A, used internally for saving presets via SysEx.

Pull asks for the program being edited (the edit buffer request, F0 00 02 4A id 06 F7) and reads the reply (Edit buffer data, id 03), every setting in it as its NRPN and value. id is the variable productId: 1 for the 24K and 24M, 2 for the 8M; the instrument takes either in a request and answers with its own. A saved program is read the same way: the program data request (F0 00 02 4A id 05 bank program F7) asks for the one the variables bank (0 - 4) and program (0 - 99) name, and its reply carries the same records after them. A Multi parameter reads part 1's value; Edit part (NRPN 0) and the rows left out above are not read.
